version.description: Version (CID) of this revision of the comment.

author.description: Account uid of the comment's author.

targetAccount.description: Account uid of the document the comment targets.

targetPath.description: Path within the target account of the document the comment targets.

targetVersion.description: Version of the target document the comment was made on.

replyParent.description: Id of the comment this one directly replies to; empty for top-level comments.

replyParentVersion.description: Version of the parent comment, when this is a reply.

threadRoot.description: Id of the top-level comment of the thread this comment belongs to.

threadRootVersion.description: Version of the thread root comment, when this is a reply.

capability.description: Id of the capability the comment was created with, if any.

updateTime.description: Time the comment was last updated.

visibility.description: Visibility inherited from the target document at creation time, `PUBLIC` or `PRIVATE`.

description: A comment as the API returns it: its content plus derived fields such as id, version, thread links, and visibility.
